title: Tacos Casserole with Chicken Taquitos and Queso
description: A hearty and cheesy casserole combining ground beef, enchilada sauce, chicken taquitos, and queso, topped with jalapeno cheddar cheese and chili cheese Fritos.

ingredients.item: Taco seasoning (quantity as per package instructions)
frozen chicken taquitos (additional, to fill the dish)
Entire bag of chili cheese Fritos

steps: Pound the ground beef and cook until it gets a little color on one side, then flip it. Add taco seasoning and cook until well combined.
Set aside the cooked beef and queso.
In a 9x13 inch deep dish Pyrex, spread about 20 ounces of red enchilada sauce on the bottom.
Place 8 chicken taquitos in the dish, gently sliding them in. Add another 8 taquitos on top if needed.
Add more enchilada sauce over the taquitos.
Spread the cooked taco meat and queso over the taquitos.
Sprinkle 2 cups of shredded jalapeno cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
Cover the dish and bake at 375°F (190°C) for about 1 hour.
After baking, if desired, remove excess grease from the top.
Top the casserole with the entire bag of chili cheese Fritos.
notes:
This dish is a hearty, indulgent meal with no health claims. Adjust ingredients as desired.
